propositions: uvicorn's timeout_graceful_shutdown is currently coupled to the certified-op drain grace (1200s), causing idle MCP retirement to hold a rotation port for the full 20 minutes and exhaust available ports in rapid deploy scenarios
the InFlightGauge early-exit mechanism via drain_then_exit is effectively dead code because uvicorn's transport backstop prevents gauge-driven early exit before the 1200s certified-op deadline

the design intent and Kubernetes/OSS precedent establish that uvicorn's timeout should be a short transport backstop (30-60s) separate from the certified-op drain deadline (1200s) enforced by gauge draining

the SIGTERM handler must not set server.should_exit until either the gauge is idle or the certified-op drain deadline elapses, preventing the short uvicorn backstop from prematurely terminating in-flight certified operations
DEFAULT_UVICORN_BACKSTOP_SECONDS must be explicitly exported with a 30-second default, and existing DEFAULT_UVICORN_GRACEFUL_SECONDS imports must remain compatible as an alias
tests must verify that idle-gauge retirement exits quickly (well under 1200s) and that busy-gauge retirement respects the certified-op drain grace even when uvicorn's backstop is shorter
